name: Developer Documentation & API Reference
description: Authoring comprehensive developer-facing content: REST/GraphQL/gRPC API references, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, quickstarts, tutorials, code samples in multiple languages, SDK guides, and CLI references.

subskills.name: OpenAPI & Swagger Spec Authoring
subskills.description: Writing and editing OpenAPI Specification (OAS 3.0/3.1) and Swagger YAML/JSON files with schemas, parameters, request bodies, and response codes.

subskills.name: REST API Endpoint Reference Documentation
subskills.description: Crafting accurate REST endpoint documentation: HTTP methods, path/query/header parameters, pagination, rate limits, authentication (Bearer, OAuth2, API Keys), and error models.

subskills.name: Multi-Language Code Samples & cURL Snippets
subskills.description: Writing clean, executable code snippets and cURL commands across multiple programming languages (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Java, cURL).

subskills.name: Developer Quickstarts & Sandbox Tutorials
subskills.description: Authoring step-by-step developer quickstarts ('Hello World' to first API call in under 5 minutes), interactive tutorials, and sandbox guides.

subskills.name: Client SDKs & Package Documentation
subskills.description: Documenting client SDKs, package installation (npm, pip, cargo, maven), client initialization, exception handling, and idiomatic usage patterns.

subskills.name: GraphQL, gRPC & Event-Driven AsyncAPI Docs
subskills.description: Documenting non-REST architectures: GraphQL schemas (queries, mutations, subscriptions), gRPC/Protobuf service definitions, and event-driven AsyncAPI/Webhooks.

subskills.name: CLI Command Reference & Terminal Guides
subskills.description: Writing comprehensive CLI references: commands, subcommands, flags/options, environment variables, exit codes, and shell completion instructions.

subskills.name: API Error Handling & Diagnostic Catalogs
subskills.description: Documenting comprehensive error catalogs, machine-readable error codes, RFC 7807 Problem Details, root causes, and programmatic resolution steps.

subskills.name: Developer Portal Architecture & DX Design
subskills.description: Designing developer portal user experience (DX), interactive API consoles (Swagger UI, Redoc, Stoplight, Scalar, ReadMe), and code snippet generators.

subskills.name: API Versioning, Deprecation & Migration Guides
subskills.description: Authoring API versioning strategies, deprecation notices, breaking change policies, and step-by-step version migration guides.

github.signal: OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0/3.1 specification files and schema definitions
REST endpoint reference documentation with HTTP methods and headers
Multi-language executable code snippets and cURL commands
5-minute developer quickstart guides and sample onboarding walkthroughs
github.pattern: docs/quickstart\.md|5-minute quickstart|Send your first|Your First API Call

github.signal: Official client SDK package documentation and installation guides
github.pattern: npm install @|pip install|cargo add|new AcmeClient\(|client = Acme\(

github.signal: GraphQL, gRPC, Protobuf, or AsyncAPI webhook documentation
CLI command reference pages and terminal options
RFC 7807 problem details and API error troubleshooting catalog
Developer portal theme customization and interactive API console configs
API migration guides, breaking change policies, and version sunset notices
github.pattern: docs/migrations/|Migrating from v1 to v2|Breaking Changes|Deprecation Policy

cv.signal: Designed and published REST/GraphQL/gRPC developer documentation and OpenAPI 3.0 specs for public developer portals
Authored interactive 5-minute quickstarts, client SDK reference guides, and multi-language executable code samples (Python, JS, Go)
Authored API error catalogs (RFC 7807) and managed major API version migration guides and breaking change policies

linkedin.signal: Recognized for expertise in Developer Experience (DX), API Documentation, OpenAPI/Swagger, and SDK Documentation

assessment.signal: Passes technical developer documentation assessment covering OpenAPI schemas, REST reference entries, SDK guides, and migration paths

junior.description: Writes OpenAPI YAML specs, REST endpoint reference docs, cURL/code snippets, and 5-minute developer quickstarts.

mid.description: Documents client SDKs, GraphQL/gRPC/AsyncAPI schemas, command line tools, and detailed error troubleshooting catalogs.

senior.description: Architects developer portal experiences (DX), establishes API deprecation policies, and authors complex breaking change migration guides.
